firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently held a snail in their hand starts and rolls both dice.
clarifications: Turns then proceed clockwise. The same booklet provides beginner and pro sides of the board without a different starting rule.

internalEvidence: A complete HABA-authored multilingual manual is preserved by the Agatinsvet retailer. The cover identifies Snail Sprint and HABA's Spiele Bad Rodach ©2018. Its English printed/PDF page 7 names the person who last held a snail, instructs them to roll both dice, and specifies clockwise order. Page 7 was rendered and read. The direct HABA manual was not located during this review. Downloaded source SHA-256: 9b65be0f3380d107b1eca105af413771f179c8ab29e1c3b271bb02c0f5923c3c. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The source gives no tie-break or method if nobody has held a snail.
